description: Dependency updates (ADR-048 'Supply chain and repository settings', WP-6 D9): grouped, weekly, three days after release, never merged without a review.

packageRules.description: Development tools, non-major updates in one pull request. Matched by name: the catalog in pnpm-workspace.yaml has no dependency type.
The Nest family, non-major updates in one pull request.
OpenTelemetry, non-major updates in one pull request.
GitHub Actions, SHA and version comment together, in one pull request. Majors stay alone. A digest update with no version change means a moved tag: review it as a warning sign.

customManagers.description: Container images run with `docker run` in the workflows and the root scripts (gitleaks, zizmor), written as name:tag@digest. One pull request updates every file that names the image. GHCR returns no release dates, so the cooldown holds these updates on the dependency dashboard until a box there is ticked.
